shuttle_notes: No port shuttles are provided or necessary as the cruise terminal exits directly into central Messina.

rail_stations.name: Messina Centrale Railway Station
rail_stations.description: Located a flat 10-minute walk south of the port along the waterfront.

popular_routes.transfer_notes: From Taormina-Giardini station, passengers take a local connecting shuttle bus or taxi (~10 min) up the steep hill to Taormina town.

city_tram.name: Tranvia di Messina (Messina City Tram)
city_tram.description: Runs directly along Via Vittorio Emanuele II outside the port gates, connecting the terminal to Messina Centrale station and northern suburbs.

taxi_services.regulatory_status: Taxis queue outside the port gates.

pricing_guidelines.taormina_round_trip_eur: 120.00 - 150.00 (Total for up to 4 passengers, 4-5 hours total with 2-3 hours wait time)
pricing_guidelines.negotiation_rule: Always negotiate and confirm the total price and waiting time before entering the vehicle.

transit_options.route: Direct buses run between Catania Airport and Messina Central Station
